metadata.title: BLDR Epoch//01 | Solana developer event, San Francisco
metadata.description: BLDR Epoch//01 is a two-day Solana campus for developers, founders, and AI engineers. San Francisco, March 9–10, 2027. Workshops, live coding, and demos.

hero.title: BLDR Epoch//01
hero.tagline: Two days of building, for developers.

about.heading: Built for builders, by builders
about.imageAlt: A builder smiling and holding up a peace sign in a crowd at night
about.intro: Solana Builder Epoch//01 is a campus for ambitious developers, founders, and AI engineers to learn, build, and push the boundaries of what’s possible.
about.body: Hands-on workshops, live coding, technical deep dives, and demos. Meet the people building the tools, work through hard problems together, and explore what becomes possible when AI, open infrastructure, and programmable money meet.

street.name: The Street
street.description: Between the two. Tents, food, places to sit and talk.

newToSolana.question: I’ve never built on Solana. Is this for me?
newToSolana.answer: Yes. You don’t need to have shipped on Solana before. Expect hands-on workshops, live coding, technical deep dives, and demos.

crypto.question: Do I need to know crypto?
crypto.answer: No. If you write software, you can follow the sessions. The people building the tools are on campus, so bring your questions.

bring.question: What should I bring?
bring.answer: A laptop and a problem you want to solve.

ticket.question: How much is a ticket?
ticket.answer: Registration is on Luma. Ticket details are listed on the registration page.

comeBuild.heading: Come build.
comeBuild.pattern: The BLDR slash pattern. Click for a new one.
comeBuild.line1: Bring a laptop and a problem.
